sentences.en: Juha bought bread for three days.
He put it on the table and went to sleep.
In the morning he found all the bread was short.
He said: there is a mouse in the house.

sentences.ar: تاني يوم، الخبز واللبن كمان ناقصين.
sentences.en: The next day, the bread and the milk were both short.

sentences.ar: قال جحا: هلق صار عندي فار وقطة.
sentences.en: Juha said: now I have a mouse and a cat.
